items: Identify the time reference first: now, finished past, continuing situation, or future.
Look for signal words: since, for, already, yesterday, while, before, by.
Check the subject: he/she/it usually takes -s in Present Simple.
Check auxiliaries: do/does/did, have/has/had, be, will, and modals.
Read the whole sentence; the clause around the blank often determines the answer.
For grammar correction, check tense, subject–verb agreement, verb form, articles, prepositions, and countable/uncountable nouns.
For conditionals, decide whether the situation is general, possible, unreal now/future, or impossible in the past.
For passive voice, identify whether the subject receives the action and preserve the tense.
